duration: Production READY. Cluster expansion respects offline zoom limits and reduced motion.
verified: Cluster expansion now caps schematic offline zoom at 3 and opens internal passport choices at that cap. Detailed-mode expansion retains its three-level step and zoom-10 ceiling. Cluster zoom respects reduced-motion preferences.
Live desktop smoke: a 17-project cluster expands; a remaining 9-project cluster opens its passport chooser in offline mode. Original 50 records, all HTML and all color files unchanged.
Added a persistent lower navigation bar to all 72 HTML pages, including passports and the branded 404. Five consistent destinations: Atlas, Projects, Tech, Evidence and Explore.
Added four internal discovery banner cards near the end of every page, plus a consistent site-topic link row. Banner choices avoid sending visitors back to the page they are already reading.
Each of the 50 project passports includes next/previous project links and a country directory banner. The next/previous links form a complete cycle across all 50 records.

Navigation is static and works without JavaScript. It includes safe-area spacing, keyboard skip links, visible focus, current-page states, responsive layouts and reduced-motion handling. Existing floating home shortcuts are visually replaced by the shared bar; the Up button sits above it.

Live desktop checks confirm the Kiel banner opens Network Rail, the bar remains fixed/visible, directory current-page state works, Explore reaches the banners, and the atlas dialog makes the bar inert until dismissal.
Vercel confirms READY. All 136 exposed deployment hashes match. Public stylesheet, passport HTML, branded 404 response and original dataset match source bytes.
tests: Latest batch: 2,000/2,000 record-field export cases (50 projects × 10 text fields × 4 text variants). Each case verifies directory/comparison CSV values by column name and exact directory/comparison/passport JSON records, including formula protection and temporary-anchor cleanup. Synthetic fixture changes only; no application source change or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 review queue transition sequences. Ten sequences for each three-record synthetic fixture verify exact audit records/flags through search/country/flag changes, reset, and review/all/flagged scope transitions. Empty views give feedback; all scope remains independent of review filters. No app changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 atlas history-event sequences. Ten sequences per project cover project replacement, repeated known/unknown routes, closing/reopening and recovery. At each step verify selected identity, filters, drawer/backdrop, inert background, focus and scroll restoration. Local controlled popstate events; no source changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 directory filter transition sequences. Ten sequences per project verify exact displayed IDs/order, URL parameters, JSON records/count and filter metadata at every step. Includes country/region/category/year intersections, clearing individual filters, changing sorting, exact search and full reset. No app changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 comparison transition sequences. Ten explicit selection/removal/reselection/clear/loading sequences across 50 starting projects verify exact original JSON, order, URL, pressed state, hidden/disabled state and selection limit after each step. No app source changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 CSV/JSON boundary fixtures. Ten equipment-text variants per project cover commas/quotes, CRLF/LF Unicode, formula prefixes, leading whitespace/BOM and literal apostrophes. Directory and comparison CSV values agree by column name despite their existing different column orders; JSON preserves exact fixture records. No app changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 search concordance journeys across directory and atlas: uppercase, decomposed Unicode, accent stripping, reversed words, mixed whitespace, combined country/operator/region/category terms, absent terms and blank searches. Each query also restores via a fresh directory instance; matching projects open/close without losing search. No app changes or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 date boundary checks: ten validation/event sequences across 50 dates in 2024–2028. Covers current/past/future dates, clearing errors, leap-year/month/year rollover, field/window focus, visibility changes and backward calendar changes. Controlled local calendar, not device timezone emulation. No app source change or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 evidence-input boundary checks, ten source transformations per project. Valid whitespace, encoded query/fragment/path and mixed-case scheme cases preserve input; credential, HTTP, protocol-relative, IPv6 loopback and localhost cases block submit then recover to original source. Local format validation only; no external source requests or app changes.

Latest batch: 500/500 site connection journeys using links extracted from real HTML: country index; coverage country/category/region/year; operator search; passport country and next-project banners; rendered correction routes; comparison-to-atlas routes with exact exports. Local static/controlled DOM tests; no source change or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 research handoff checks, five correction and five quality-export sequences per project. Covers edited text, unresolved/retry identity, original categories, encoded unusual references, evidence-format recovery, missing fields, invalid coordinates/sources, duplicate records, accented review search and allocation recovery. Local controlled DOM/VM; no app change or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 directory recovery checks: delayed load, timeout/retry, duplicate retry prevention, URL changes during load, invalid filter normalization, CSV/JSON allocation-failure recovery, empty export feedback, full-catalog reset and history restoration. Local controlled DOM/VM; no source change or deployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 local sharing journey checks. Ten journeys for each project validate triple-selection order, each passport return, Unicode filters, query-field restrictions, companion related pairs, malformed encodings, fetch retry, canonical copy separation, loading restoration and middle-selection removal. Exact exports verified after every return. No app changes or redeployment.

Latest batch: 500/500 local controlled DOM/VM cluster recovery checks. Ten behaviors per project cover escaped chooser names, accents, search/country/type filtering, empty/reset states, fallback focus, unmapped records and stale marker removal. No source changes or redeployment.

New cluster batch: 500 local controlled DOM/VM checks, 250 passed before fix and 500 after. Ten scenarios for each of 50 project-based synthetic fixtures. Also reran 500 atlas-view checks, 500 map-state checks, atlas/passport suites, 500 discovery assertions, 72-page navigation audit and preservation/recovery suites.

New batch: 500/500 local static discovery checks across all 50 passports: destinations, exact country filters, forward/reverse 50-project cycles, valid internal routes and fragments, keyboard targets, shared styles and content preservation. No production source changes or redeployment needed.

72-page static audit passes: exactly one five-link bar, four non-self internal cards, valid local routes, unique IDs, correct active states, no new external/blank-target links, a 50-project discovery cycle and inverse previous links.

Generator idempotence passes. New CSS colors are drawn from the existing palette. Removing only the new marked navigation blocks and stylesheet link reproduces all prior HTML bytes; all original data and CSS remain byte-identical.
Existing atlas and passport behavior suites, 34 preservation checks, full navigation/link/anchor/metadata audit and 71-page sitemap/recovery checks pass.
Local managed preview service was unavailable. Live desktop visual QA was performed on production. Actual mobile/device visuals remain unverified.
